description: This Java class 'WebAppCache' manages caching of web application information retrieved from component configurations in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve web app info based on server name and menu, and maintains a shared singleton cache instance.

classes.name: WebAppCache
classes.description: A cache for storing web application information to improve performance by avoiding repeated retrieval from component configurations. It supports fetching web app info by server and menu, and retrieving specific web app info by mount point.

methods.name: WebAppCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a supplier for component configurations.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfos
methods.description: Retrieves web application info visible in the server context, optionally filtered by menu name.

methods.name: getWebappInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the first web app info matching a given web app name and server.

methods.name: getShared
methods.description: Returns a singleton shared instance of the WebAppCache.
